_README: This file is INERT as shipped: the hooks live under '_hooks_disabled' and do
nothing. To enable them, edit the commands to match your repo, then rename
the key to 'hooks'. Read every command before enabling it.
The allowlist below is the point of the exercise: it stops the
plan -> change -> verify -> fix loop from being interrupted by a prompt on
every read-only command. Replace the entries with your repo's real ones.

_hooks_disabled._note: Rename this key to 'hooks' only after editing the commands below.

PostToolUse._why: Format on write, using the repo's own formatter. Only useful if the repo already configures one.

hooks.command: REPLACE-ME: e.g. ruff format . && ruff check --fix .

PostToolUse._why: Regenerate derived files. Highest-value hook in most repos, because humans forget this step. Examples: protobuf stubs, OpenAPI clients, DB migrations, lockfiles. The matcher can only match tool names, so scope inside the command: read the hook's stdin JSON and exit 0 early unless tool_input.file_path is under the source dir — otherwise this runs on every single edit and slows the loop.

hooks.command: REPLACE-ME: e.g. a script that checks tool_input.file_path is under proto/ before running python scripts/gen_proto.py

PreToolUse._why: Guard files that must not change casually: production config, deploy pointers, live model paths.

hooks.command: REPLACE-ME: a script that exits non-zero to block the edit

PreToolUse._why: Blocks edits that ADD a check-suppression marker instead of fixing the cause (doctrine: failing test/lint means not done). Exit code 2 blocks the edit and shows the message to the agent — re-injecting the rule at the exact moment of temptation. Diff-aware: it compares marker COUNTS between the new text and the old (old_string for Edit; the on-disk file for Write), so editing code that already carries a marker passes — only introducing one blocks. Tune the marker list to your repo's languages before enabling; a justified suppression then requires the human to add it.

hooks.command: REPLACE-ME: e.g. python3 -c "import json,sys,re,pathlib; d=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}); rx=re.compile(r'noqa|type: ignore|ts-ignore|eslint-disable|[.]skip[(]|xfail'); new=len(rx.findall(d.get('new_string') or d.get('content') or '')); o=d.get('old_string'); p=pathlib.Path(d.get('file_path') or ''); old=o if o is not None else (p.read_text() if p.is_file() else ''); sys.exit(2 if new>len(rx.findall(old)) else 0)"
